title: Chronos-MTM — Symmetric D'Appolito Mastering Tower (CLD Birch + Billet Alu)
description: Full-range 25 Hz–20 kHz floorstanding mastering tower combining a symmetric Joseph D'Appolito M-T-M upper array (dual 5.5" midwoofers flanking a shallow 6061-T6 OS-SE Beryllium tweeter) with a dedicated lower 10" flared-slot bass-reflex subwoofer.
design_notes: D'Appolito Vertical Directivity Control: Placing two 5.5" midwoofers symmetrically ±150 mm above and below the 1" OS-SE tweeter creates a virtual acoustic point source at z = 840 mm while narrowing vertical dispersion between 600–2000 Hz — cutting studio desk, floor, and ceiling early reflections by 4–6 dB!

The 2/3-Wavelength MTM Crossover Rule: Open Spinorama & Polar Sonograms and switch between Variant 1 (1.75 kHz crossover, d ≈ 0.87λ) and Variant 2 (3.3 kHz crossover, d ≈ 2.9λ). At 3.3 kHz, severe ±20° vertical interference comb nulls slice through the Vertical Sonogram and Early Reflections DI!

Constrained-Layer Damped (CLD) Tall Enclosure: Tall 1.14 m towers suffer severe pipe & side-wall bending resonances unless braced and damped; 21 mm CLD viscoelastic birch + 3 window braces + 2 isolated sealed MTM sub-chambers push panel coloration below -42 dB.
